integrity: Analytic proof with deterministic finite sign-stress-test; no claim of external certification. Earlier three-band special case is acknowledged as prior.
scientific_limitations: Only finite numbers of disjoint bands with equally spaced centers and arbitrary positive widths; only centered observation intervals and fixed-Fourier-modulus universal phases. Historical priority provisional against unlocated general signed-kernel work. No independent mathematical audit.
title: Universal phase coherence for arbitrarily many unequal Fourier bands
